plugin_description: Connect Antigravity, Codex, Claude Code, and custom ACP CLI agents as models and media capabilities.
save_failed: Could not save the ACP configuration
runtime_hint: Install and inspect the CLI runtimes that ACP profiles launch. Managed runtimes live in the plugin tools directory; system runtimes must be installed on the host.
custom_packages_hint: Install any npm or Bun package that provides an ACP-compatible CLI. The package is added to this plugin's tools directory.
profiles_hint: Each profile starts one ACP CLI process and publishes its enabled models. Presets only fill in defaults; every field remains editable.
args_hint: Separate arguments with spaces or new lines.
cwd_hint: Optional. Defaults to a sandboxed artifact directory.
request_timeout_hint: Maximum runtime for a single ACP request. Defaults to 180000 ms.
idle_ttl_hint: Idle ACP processes stop after this period. Defaults to 300000 ms.
env_public_hint: KEY=VALUE, one per line. These values are stored in plain text.
env_secret_stored: Stored secrets are configured for this profile.
env_secret_hint: KEY=VALUE, one per line. Entering values replaces all stored secrets for this profile; leave blank to keep them. New values are stored as plugin secrets.
env_format_error: Use KEY=VALUE with one entry per line.
secret_env_format_error: Enter secret environment variables as KEY=VALUE, one per line.
enable_as_model_provider_hint: Expose this profile's enabled models to chat and workspace turns.
tool_bridge_mode_hint: Controls how built-in tools are offered to the ACP agent.
supports_image_generation_hint: Allow this profile to receive image-generation requests.
supports_video_generation_hint: Allow this profile to receive video-generation requests.
supports_capability_tool_hint: Register the governed ACP capability tool for image and video jobs.
allowed_capability_chat_hint: Permit ordinary chat conversations to invoke the capability tool.
probe_models_added: {count} new models added to this profile
no_profiles_hint: Start with a preset above, then adjust the command and model catalog.
models_hint: {enabled} of {total} models are enabled for this profile. Saved changes apply after the server restarts.
no_models_hint: Probe the profile to discover models, or add a model ID manually.
duplicate_model: That model is already in the catalog.
auth_login_waiting: Complete sign-in in your browser. Status will update automatically…
auth_login_expired: Sign-in for {name} timed out. Please try again.
